question: What is the meaning of disposal considerations in relation to end-of-life management?
description: Considerations related to disposal in end-of-life management involve the costs and processes associated with sorting, collecting, treating, and potentially recycling objects once they reach the end of their useful life. This includes understanding how products will be disposed of, the environmental impact of disposal methods, and any regulations or requirements that need to be followed during the disposal phase.
